raw.title: Interim Senior BI Analyst (All Genders)
raw.description:
Across Europe, fleets are under enormous pressure. Fuel costs are rising. Regulatory requirements are tightening. The shift to low-emission vehicles is accelerating. And yet around 70% of European businesses still manage their fleets manually, with spreadsheets, disconnected tools, and processes that were never built for this moment. Shiftmove exists to make this simple.

We are a profitable B2B SaaS company and the fastest-growing fleet management platform in Europe, born from the merger of Avrios and Vimcar, and now serving tens of thousands of corporate customers across Germany, France, Spain, Switzerland, Poland, and beyond. Most recently, we acquired Optimum and Ocean in France, expanding our footprint and doubling down on one of Europe's largest fleet markets. Our AI-powered platform connects real-time vehicle data with intelligent software so that businesses can procure smarter, control costs, stay compliant, and lead the transition to cleaner mobility, all from one place.

About the role:

We are looking for an experienced Interim Senior BI Analyst to join us on an initial three-month contract, with the option to extend for a further three months.

As we integrate two acquired French businesses into our group, we need to bring their data into our standard reporting while transforming how our executive team accesses and uses business intelligence. Our existing Tableau dashboards have evolved over time, and we see an opportunity to make them clearer, more consistent and more actionable.

Reporting to our VP of Operations, Data & BI, you will work closely with the executive team, Head of FP&A, RevOps and Data Engineering. You will take ownership of rebuilding our executive reporting, responding to daily analytical requests and ensuring that acquired-company data is accurately reflected in group-wide reporting.

This is a hands-on role for someone who combines strong technical BI skills with commercial acumen, sound analytical judgement and the confidence to challenge senior stakeholders when the data tells a different story.

What You'll Do

  • Rebuild executive reporting: Audit our existing Tableau dashboards and the underlying business logic. Decide which dashboards to retain, consolidate, redesign or retire, and rebuild the priority dashboards so executives can quickly understand performance and make informed decisions
  • Establish consistent metrics: Document and align metric definitions to ensure that business performance is measured consistently across dashboards, teams and entities
  • Own daily ad hoc reporting: Manage requests through our Jira-based data support queue, prioritising, scoping and delivering analyses on a daily basis. Translate ambiguous requests into clear business questions and identify recurring needs that can be addressed through standard reporting
  • Integrate acquisition data: Partner with Data Engineering as acquired-company data is migrated into Snowflake. Validate and reconcile data against source systems, build and maintain dbt models, and incorporate the data into existing Tableau dashboards so group reporting reflects all entities
  • Deliver commercial insights: Translate executive requirements into meaningful analysis of go-to-market performance, including pipeline, bookings, ARR, retention and churn
  • Partner with Finance: Work closely with the Head of FP&A to reconcile BI reporting with financial figures and establish a consistent view of business performance
  • Present findings and challenge assumptions: Communicate insights directly to the executive team, explain what the data means for the business, and challenge assumptions where the evidence supports a different conclusion
  • Enable a smooth handover: Document dashboards, data models, metric definitions and reporting processes so the permanent BI team can take ownership of the work at the end of the interim period

What You Need to Succeed

  • You bring extensive experience in BI or analytics, including at least three years working at a senior level
  • You have expert-level Tableau dashboard development skills, including experience redesigning dashboards for executive audiences
  • You have strong SQL skills and hands-on experience working with Snowflake
  • You have practical experience with dbt, including building and maintaining data models, tests and documentation
  • You understand go-to-market performance and are fluent in metrics such as pipeline, bookings, ARR, net and gross retention, and churn
  • You have a track record of translating executive requirements into analysis that informs business decisions
  • You have experience integrating acquired, migrated or otherwise disparate data sources into existing reporting environments
  • You are comfortable managing a Jira ticket queue and delivering reporting requests within daily turnaround expectations
  • You communicate exceptionally well in written and spoken English and are confident presenting to C-level stakeholders, including challenging assumptions when the data warrants it
  • You are based in Europe and available to work 35 hours per week for the duration of the contract

Nice to have:

  • French or German language skills
  • Experience in a SaaS or subscription-based business
  • Experience working with Salesforce, HubSpot or NetSuite data models
  • Experience building a semantic layer or self-service analytics capabilities for executive stakeholders
  • Experience reporting to private equity investors or preparing board-level reporting packs

What Success Looks Like

We want you to make a tangible impact from the start

  • By Day 30: Complete an audit of existing dashboards and underlying business logic, with a clear recommendation to retain, consolidate, redesign or retire each dashboard. Take ownership of the Jira queue and establish a reliable daily delivery rhythm
  • By Day 90: Have the priority executive dashboards rebuilt and in use, agree metric definitions with the Head of FP&A, and bring the first acquired-company data into standard group reporting
  • By Day 180 (if extended): Complete the rebuild of all in-scope dashboards, incorporate all migrated acquisition data into standard reporting, convert recurring ad hoc requests into standard reports, and complete the handover to the permanent BI team

Why Shiftmove

Why should you join us? At Shiftmove, you can contribute to an established, product-led company focused on delivering real value to its customers, with meaningful recurring revenue and an ambitious agenda for growth

  • Autonomy: We bring you in for your expertise and give you the ownership and space to deliver meaningful results.
  • Impact: Play a direct role in shaping executive reporting and integrating acquired businesses into a consistent, group-wide view of performance
  • Fair and equitable compensation: Interim compensation will be discussed based on your expertise, experience and geographic location
  • Dog-friendly office: Because furry coworkers make everything better! 🐶

SOUNDS LIKE YOU?

If you don't tick all the boxes but believe you can thrive in this role, we would love to hear from you.

Shiftmove is an equal opportunity employer. We believe diverse experiences and demographic characteristics that have nurtured unique viewpoints benefit our growth and performance. Just be yourself, and maybe you'll bring something valuable to the role we didn't initially think of.

If you need specific accommodations (tools, time, etc.) due to any special needs, and you are happy to disclose this, please let us know. We are happy to make adjustments, as support can make a decisive difference in the application process.

Our culture is innovative, collaborative and performance focused. Du greifst proaktiv ein, sobald Zeit-KPIs überschritten werden oder Risiken für Durchlaufzeit, Profitabilität oder Kundenzufriedenheit entstehen. Du gewährleistest, dass Projekte vollständig, baubar und jederzeit korrekt im System abgebildet sind und kein Projekt verloren geht. Du behältst die Vollständigkeit der Projektunterlagen im Blick – erkennst frühzeitig, was fehlt, und sorgst dafür, dass es rechtzeitig vorliegt. Du hast die Profitabilität pro Projekt im Griff: Engpässe und Wartezeiten identifizierst du rechtzeitig, bevor sie auf das Ergebnis drücken. Du arbeitest eng mit dem Customer Support Team zusammen und übernimmst die proaktive, projektspezifische Kommunikation zu definierten Kontaktpunkten. Du schaffst transparente und aktuelle Projektstatus und gibst jederzeit Klarheit über Blocker und Handlungsbedarf. Du baust die Prozesse für PV-Projekte aktiv mit auf und entwickelst sie kontinuierlich weiter, da es sie bei uns in dieser Form noch nicht gibt. Dein Profil Abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung oder Studium in einem relevanten Bereich (z. B. Technik, Handwerk, Energie, Wirtschaft) oder vergleichbare Praxiserfahrung im Projekt- oder Operationsumfeld. Erfahrung im Projektmanagement, in Operations oder in einem technischen Umfeld (z. B. Bau, Handwerk, Energie). Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch in Wort und Schrift (C2). Sicherer Umgang mit CRM-Systemen und digitalen Tools. Erfahrung im Umfeld Photovoltaik, Wärmepumpe oder erneuerbare Energien ist ein Plus. Zusätzlich sind uns folgende Fähigkeiten und Eigenschaften wichtig: Ownership – Wenn ein Projekt ins Stocken gerät, hast du das Problem längst erkannt – und bereits gehandelt. Du treibst Projekte intern konsequent voran, adressierst Abhängigkeiten klar und verbindlich gegenüber anderen Teams, und bleibst so lange dran bis das Ergebnis steht. Expert Operator – Du hast viele Projekte gleichzeitig im Blick – und weißt bei jedem, wo es steht, was als nächstes passieren muss und wo Gefahr droht. Prozesse und Prioritäten sind deine Werkzeuge, um auch bei hohem Volumen handlungsfähig zu bleiben. Data-Driven Optimizer – Cycle Time, Profitabilität, Terminierungen & Projektfortschritt – du schaust täglich auf deine KPIs, erkennst Muster bevor sie zum Problem werden und nutzt diese Erkenntnisse, um deinen Prozess kontinuierlich zu schärfen. Commercially Minded – Du weißt, dass Verzögerungen nicht nur Kunden frustrieren – sie fressen direkt in die Profitabilität. Du erkennst frühzeitig, wenn Wartezeiten oder Eskalationen auf das Ergebnis drücken, und steuerst aktiv dagegen. Proactive Problem Solver – Fehlende Unterlagen, blockierter Installationstermin, unerreichbarer Kunde – du lässt dich davon nicht aufhalten. Du findest einen Weg und sorgst dafür, dass das Projekt weiterläuft.   • Data Contracts & Schema Governance: Establish strict data contracts (Pydantic, dbt contracts) and schema management, ensuring dataset reproducibility, data lineage tracking, and automated validation across all platform pipelines.

  • Platform Efficiency & Cloud Infrastructure: Optimize data storage, query execution, and compute costs across AWS and Snowflake, keeping data assets performant, secure, and cost-effective.

  • Automation & CI/CD: Implement automated testing and deployment workflows for data pipelines using GitHub Actions and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform).

  • Cross-Functional Data Enablement: Partner directly with Analytics Engineers, Data Scientists, and domain experts to deliver documented, research-grade, and production-ready datasets.

Qualifications

  • Entity Resolution & Data Governance: Practical experience with entity resolution/record linkage frameworks (e.g., Splink, dedupe, recordlinkage) and schema management/data contracts (Pydantic, dbt contracts, or JSON Schema).

  • Cloud Platform & Warehouse Infrastructure: Deep hands-on experience in an AWS production environment (S3, ECS/EC2) combined with cloud data warehouses (Snowflake).

  • Automated CI/CD & Workflow Automation: Proven track record of automating data pipeline deployments, integration tests, and validation workflows via GitHub Actions.

  • Knowledge Graphs & Healthcare Terminologies: Exposure to ontology/semantic frameworks (RDF/OWL, SKOS, Neo4j, LinkML) or international medical classifications/vocabularies (SNOMED CT, ICD/OPS, FHIR).

  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Proficiency in using Terraform to declaratively manage cloud resources and environments.

  • Mindset: Strong analytical and systems mindset, with a proven ability to transform messy, heterogeneous international data into a clean, well-governed, and highly structured data asset.

  • Working Style: Highly structured, curious, detail-oriented, and motivated to collaborate closely with analytics engineers, data scientists, and methodology experts in an international environment.

raw.title: Senior Product Owner (m/f/d)
raw.description:
At Flix, we offer a tech-driven environment where innovation meets real-world impact, with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a culture of collaboration and ownership.  

As a Senior Product Owner (m/f/d) in Supply division you will make an impact by owning the problem space of supporting operational staff in the field, driving the full product lifecycle from discovery to outcome measurement, working in close partnership with a global landscape of stakeholders, and shaping the next generation of our products. 

At the centre of this problem space is an app supporting bus drivers, train attendants and station staff in their daily operations around the world. This Android application does not only provide key workflows to its users, but also allows Flix to better understand operational compliance in the field so we can guarantee the best possible passenger experience.  

We're currently building the next generation of this app, making this an exciting moment to join and shape its long-term direction. 

Your engineering counterparts are an Engineering Manager, three Backend engineers, two Mobile engineers and one Data Analyst. Your focus will be on strategy, discovery, and outcomes, while the engineering team owns delivery and ceremonies. 

If you're excited about working on a constantly evolving product used by thousands of operational staff around the world, send us your application! 

About the Role

  • Own the product lifecycle end-to-end: from identifying opportunities and running discovery, through shaping solutions and defining requirements, to measuring outcomes and closing the loop 
  • Co-own your problem space with business counterparts, building a joint partnership that replaces handover-based collaboration with shared accountability for outcomes 
  • Define product strategy and priorities for the app, working across teams and problem spaces rather than being bounded by a single team's scope 
  • Drive hypothesis-driven discovery and outcome measurement, defining success metrics before solution work begins and using them to make explicit continue, pivot, or stop decisions 
  • Partner closely with engineering on priorities, requirements, and release, trusting the EM and team to own delivery and ceremonies 
  • Collaborate with peer Product Owners to align on dependencies and deliver outcomes that span individual team boundaries

About You

  • 5+ years as a Product Owner or Product Manager, with a track record of owning products end-to-end: from problem discovery and business alignment to outcome measurement
  • You think in outcomes and problem spaces; presenting a business case to a stakeholder feels as natural as running a discovery session with users
  • Proven ability to build strong working relationships with business stakeholders and drive joint decision-making without relying on formal authority
  • Experience owning product problems that cut across team boundaries, keeping multiple stakeholders aligned on direction and trade-offs
  • You're energised by strategy, discovery, and outcomes; you understand that delivery coordination sits with the engineering team
  • Strong analytical foundation; you can connect user research, usability signals, and business metrics to make confident product decisions
  • Nice-to-have: Experience with mobile app products, ideally in an operational or logistics context 

We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you!  

What We Offer

  • Travel perks: 12 free Flix vouchers + 12 discount vouchers for friends & family. 
  • Work from (M)Anywhere: Depending on your role, work from another location for up to 60 days per year. 
  • Hybrid work model: We are an office-first company, but we offer flexibility to balance work and life. 
  • Wellbeing support: Access confidential 1:1 counselling, courses, and stress management for yourself and up to four family members. 
  • Learning & Development: Take advantage of language classes, training courses, and expert-led sessions to grow your skills. 
  • Mentoring Program: Connect with experienced colleagues to gain insights and accelerate your career. 

To view more local benefits specific to each office location, please check out this link: Locations - Flix Career

Why Join Flix?

At Flix, we empower our teams to push boundaries and shape the future of mobility. As we continue to scale globally, we harness cutting-edge technology to make mobility smarter, more sustainable, and more affordable.

If you're looking for a place where you can drive change and redefine how millions of people travel, Flix is the place where you can lead your journey!

We collaborate to close the gap between proven, life-saving solutions and the people who need them. </span><span data-contrast="none">Since 2017, </span><span data-contrast="none">we’ve</span><span data-contrast="none"> worked with governments and other partners in more than 60 countries to save millions of lives. This is an ambitious vision, and it inspires us and our partners to make progress every day.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></p></div><p>Resolve to Save Lives' Prevent Epidemics program works closely with Ministries of Health and national public health institutes in Africa to strengthen epidemic preparedness capacity, accelerate disease detection and response, and effectively use data to inform action. title: Commercial Specialist
description: Powering Great Work We started as the place to find a trusted trade. Now, as we shape the future of home improvement, we're building the tech to transform that landscape for everyone - better products, smarter data, AI where it actually helps - so trades can spend less time on admin and consumers can find someone they trust, first time. That's Powering Great Work, and it's why every team here exists: 🔧 Trades spend less time on admin and more on winning work and growing their business 🏠 Homeowners get a trusted trade, first time, every time 🚀 We get to build products that change homes and lives across the country As our next Account Executive, you'll help bring more trades onto Checkatrade across different regions and categories. It's a new business role: you find high-potential trade businesses and guide them from the first conversation to a signed deal. You'll sit in our Strategic Growth team, at the heart of how we grow the trade network that homeowners rely on. The job, unfiltered: Win new trade businesses by finding high-potential small and medium trades, building proposals that make sense for them and negotiating terms. Hand each new trade over smoothly to our vetting team, so the start of their Checkatrade journey goes well. Spot opportunities in the market, using data and insights to see where Checkatrade is strong and where we can grow. Work with Account Management, Vetting, Product and Operations to find the regions and categories that would benefit most from Checkatrade. This is not a project role with occasional site visits and it is not a desk job, the forward work happens along with running the operation.

 

Who will thrive in this role

  • Deliver shift plan end to end people deployment, throughput, quality standards, and health & safety compliance

  • Lead, develop, and performance-manage a frontline team of 50–100+ operatives

  • Build the mechanisms that hold the operation together. Build controls, cadences, metrics, SOPs, change management and own their adoption, not only their design

  • Plan ahead for future shifts; labour, training, and the risks you can see coming before they land

  • Own the end-of-shift handover; what happened, what is at risk, what the next shift needs to know

  • Stay decisive through volume peaks, outages, and labour gaps. Triage, solve the problem at hand quickly, contain the impact, restore flow

  • Present and write clearly whether briefs, escalations, handovers or post-incident reviews. Decisions here get made based off what you wrote

  • Implement changes into a live operation such as introducing robotics, launching new sortation tech or onboarding new clients. We are changing the operations constantly which means you’ll roll change out mid flight and bring your team along the journey.

 

Who you are

  • Scaled something from zero: a site, a market, a process or a program.

  • Managed a physical operation: quick commerce, grocery, e-commerce fulfillment, last mile, 3PL, food production, airport ground handling, rail. Anywhere with a hard cut off and people on the floor.

  • Communicate in both directions and have strong people management skills: you can brief 80 operatives at shift start and take a problem to senior leadership the same day.

  • Built a mechanism that held: a control, a cadence, a metric, a document standard. Something you authored that changed how frontline teams worked.

  • Own numbers rather than report them: you can name a metric you created or redefined, explain why the previous one was wrong, and say what changed afterwards.

  • Understand frontline work: one of these must be true: you have personally led frontline teams; you have worked embedded in and around a frontline population day to day, without the reporting line; or you have been accountable for outcomes delivered by frontline people you did not employ.

You do not need to have worked in parcels, fulfilment, or sortation. Several of our most talented people had not.

 

Backgrounds that translate well

  • Program Manager in a logistics or e-commerce business

  • Operations Excellence and Continuous Improvement

  • Strategy & Operations

  • Transformation manager

  • Launch and Expansion Manager

  • Regional operations manager

We build the auction mechanics, the pricing and pacing logic, and the low-latency systems that run them, balancing outcomes for advertisers, publishers, viewers, and Roku on every request. We are growing the team in Cambridge, which is becoming its largest hub, alongside colleagues in Amsterdam, Austin, San Jose, Ukraine and Uruguay — so you would be shaping how the UK side of this team works rather than inheriting it.</p> <h3><strong>What is the role?</strong></h3> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>You will build the systems that apply mathematical and algorithmic rigour to optimise across multiple objectives, deciding which ads get served, in which placements, and when. The work spans auction mechanics, optimisation, the output of predictive ML models, and the real-time infrastructure underneath, mostly in Java on the JVM. It is hands-on and senior in scope: expect to move between whiteboard-level design and production code in the same week, and to own problems from framing through rollout. You will work directly with the hiring manager and a small group of senior engineers, in codebases shared with other ads engineers, on problems where your decisions are visible in revenue. You will optimise for second-order effects in a marketplace where participants react to each other, and to us, in real time. We are looking for people who are enthusiastic about solving these kinds of problems.</p> <h3><strong>How will I use AI at Roku?</strong></h3> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>At Roku, we don't just use AI, we work with it. publishers, viewers, and Roku each want from the same impression</li> <li>Own development work end to end, from framing the problem through production rollout</li> <li>Build and operate JVM services where latency and reliability are product requirements, not stretch goals</li> <li>Use probability, statistics and experimentation to test changes before and after launch</li> <li>Work with AI tooling as a normal part of how you design, build, test and review</li> <li>Explain technical trade-offs clearly to engineering and cross-functional partners</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What experience would help someone be successful in this role at Roku?</strong></h3> <p>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Around six or more years building production software, with strong systems judgement</li> <li>Production experience in Java or another JVM language, or depth in a comparable statically typed language such as C#, C++ or Go, and the appetite to ramp on Java</li> <li>Comfort designing and operating distributed systems at scale and low latency</li> <li>A solid grounding in maths, algorithms, probability and statistics as applied to real systems</li> <li>Demonstrated AI and agentic-tooling fluency, as described above</li> <li>Ad tech, auctions or marketplace experience is preferred, and we move quickly for candidates who have it</li> <li>Comparable experience on mathematically rigorous or optimisation-heavy problems in another domain is an acceptable alternative</li> </ul> <h6>#LI-MS3</h6><div class="content-conclusion"><h3><strong><span style="font-family: GothamBold, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;">What's Roku's approach to hybrid working?</span></strong></h3> <p>Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;"><strong>What are some of the benefits?</strong></h3> <p>Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). Employees are supported in taking time off, in accordance with local leave policies and other personal needs to support their evolving work and life needs. It's important to note that not every benefit is available in all locations or for every role. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;"><strong>Accommodations</strong></h3> <p>Roku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please direct your inquiries to <a ---------- <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;"><strong>What should I know about Roku's culture?</strong></h3> <p>Roku is a great place for people who want to work in a fast-paced environment where everyone is focused on the company's success rather than their own. description: LOCATION: CALMSDEN, CIRENCESTER, UK. LIMITED FIELD TRAVEL AS REQUIRED | 5 DAYS ONSITE THE LAST FRONTIER ARD was founded on a paradox. The Arctic is both the next great economic frontier and one of the most hostile environments on Earth. Rich in resources and strategically vital, yet bone-chillingly cold, dark for months, and fundamentally inhospitable to humans. This paradox - an explosion of activity in a place that resists human presence - is why we exist. Our solution is autonomy. We build systems that operate reliably and intelligently in the Arctic, so that humans don't always have to. Founded by record-holding pioneers with decades of polar experience, we take calculated risks on hard problems that matter. If you want to build and deploy ground-up technology with real-world impact, at an inflection point in history that won’t reappear, we’d like to talk. THE ROLE ARD is growing and we’re looking for an Assembly and Test Technician to help us build and test our ruggedized hardware - from field-ready energy and battery systems to the autonomous platforms we deploy in the Arctic. Right now, our biggest constraint isn’t design. It’s the time it takes to assemble and test what we’ve designed. Reporting to our Senior Test Engineer , you’ll join our engineering team, working alongside our mechanical and electrical engineers and across our main hardware workstreams. You’ll take hands-on ownership of assembly and testing, helping with the practical implementation and testing of engineering designs. Within your first 3 months, you’ll have helped to take assembly and test off the critical path on our key projects, and helped put in place the documentation and test processes that let us build and test consistently, unit after unit. CORE RESPONSIBILITIES Assemble mechanical and electrical sub-assemblies, harnesses, PCBAs, and complete units to drawings and build instructions, so they’re ready for test on schedule. Run test phases on assemblies and finished units and record the results accurately, so issues are found and fixed before hardware reaches the field. Help set up repeatable test processes, from test plans and rigs to how results are captured, working closely with our Senior Test Engineer. Write and maintain build instructions, test procedures and records, raising the standard of our engineering documentation as we scale. Spot and report problems found during build and test, giving engineers the detail they need to debug and improve the next design revision. REQUIREMENTS About You You’re a practical, hands-on technician who takes pride in building things properly and getting the details right. You’re methodical, you like a clear process, and you’d rather write something down than rely on memory. You might come from a technician role in engineering, manufacturing or a test lab, an engineering apprenticeship, the armed forces, or a mechanical or electrical engineering degree with plenty of hands-on build experience. * Please note: this role is not eligible for visa sponsorship * Essential An engineering qualification (such as an HNC/HND, apprenticeship or degree in mechanical or electrical engineering), or equivalent hands-on experience. Hands-on experience assembling mechanical or electrical hardware in a workshop, lab or production setting. Experience with basic soldering equipment Ability to work from engineering drawings, schematics and written build instructions. Experience running tests on hardware and recording the results accurately. Confident using common workshop tools and electrical test equipment, such as multimeters and bench power supplies. Comfortable owning your own tasks with guidance from the engineering team, and raising problems early when a build or test doesn’t go to plan. Desirable Experience writing or improving build instructions, test procedures or other technical documentation. Experience with electrical assembly such as wiring looms, crimping or soldering, or working with battery systems. Experience building hardware in small batches or repeat runs, rather than one-off prototypes. Experience with surface-mount PCB assembly Future Security Clearance Requirements As our business scales into the defence and security sectors, the responsibilities of this role are expected to evolve to include projects requiring UK Security Check (SC) clearance . While an active clearance is not required to apply or start in this role, candidates must be willing and eligible to undergo UK Government security vetting in the future should project requirements dictate it. To meet the standard eligibility criteria for UK standard SC vetting, you must typically have resided in the UK for the past 5 continuous years , hold a valid passport, and be capable of passing comprehensive background, financial, and criminal record checks. Why ARD The mission - The Arctic is the fastest-changing region on Earth. You'll build the intelligence layer that helps understand and steward it — an early-warning system for the planet's coldest edge. Early stage, real influence - ARD is at an exciting early stage. You'll join while our products, team and culture are still taking shape, and your ideas will directly influence where we go next. Ownership and accountability - We give people real responsibility from day one. You'll own your work end to end, be trusted to make decisions, and be accountable for delivering results that ship and get used. A small but growing team - You'll work closely with experienced colleagues across science, software and hardware, with no layers in between. As we grow, you'll help build the team and the ways of working that come next. WHAT WE OFFER Competitive compensation Private Health Insurance from Day 1 Dental & Vision Equity - meaningful options as an early employee at an early-stage company Real field exposure - travel to Arctic sites and Outposts when needed Mission-driven culture - focus on impact, not hours logged ARD is an equal opportunities employer. We hire on merit, based on skills, experience and potential, and welcome applications from everyone regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sex or sexual orientation. We know great candidates sometimes hold back unless they tick every box, so if this role excites you but your experience doesn’t match every point, we’d still love to hear from you, especially if you bring a background or perspective that is under-represented in science and engineering. If you need any adjustments during the application or interview process, please don't hesitate to let us know at #LI-TK1 Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

  • Make sure the team builds well across the whole lifecycle: reliable data pipelines, high-quality features, rigorous offline and online evaluation (including A/B testing), reliable deployment, monitoring and ongoing maintenance

  • Lead the team in building production-grade agentic systems, using orchestration harnesses such as LangGraph to design multi-step workflows, tool use and human-in-the-loop controls

  • Make evaluation a first-class engineering discipline for LLM and agent work. That means curated eval sets, LLM-as-judge and human review, tracing, regression testing of prompts and agents, and online monitoring of quality, cost and latency

  • Set the guardrails for responsible use of AI, covering safety, privacy and clear fallbacks when an agent shouldn’t act on its own

  • Raise the bar on engineering practice through code and design reviews, CI/CD, MLOps, observability and on-call

  • Build strong relationships with senior leaders and partner teams, explaining progress, trade-offs and impact in plain language

  • Contribute to our wider AI and ML community and help keep a culture of learning, curiosity and experimentation

We’d love to hear from you if you have... 🔎

  • Experience line-managing engineers, including hiring, performance management and career development

  • A strong background as an ML engineer, with a track record of taking models into production and keeping them healthy at scale

  • Enough grounding in data engineering (pipelines, data modelling and data quality) to lead data engineers as well as ML engineers

  • Solid Python and software engineering fundamentals, with enough hands-on depth to review code and designs credibly

  • Depth in at least one area such as ranking and recommendation, predictive modelling, optimisation or NLP, backed by a solid grasp of statistics, experimentation and feature engineering

  • Experience with modern ML infrastructure on a major cloud platform, ideally AWS, covering distributed data processing, orchestration, model management and infrastructure as code

  • Hands-on experience shipping agentic or LLM-based systems, including agent orchestration frameworks, tool use, RAG, and fine-tuning where it earns its place

  • A disciplined approach to evaluating LLM and agent systems, using tools such as Braintrust, and a clear view on how to know whether an agent is working well in production

  • Clear communication with technical and non-technical colleagues, and good judgement on priorities when there’s more to do than people to do it

Our tech stack 💻

We build mostly in Python on AWS, and choose tools for what they do in production rather than for novelty. You don’t need to know all of it on day one.

  • Data and compute: S3, Athena, Spark on EMR, SQL

  • Orchestration and MLOps: Airflow, MLflow, Docker, ECS, Terraform, GitHub Actions for CI/CD

  • Models: foundation models served through Amazon Bedrock

  • Agents: LangGraph for orchestration, deployed and run on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, with MCP for tool integration

  • Evaluation: Braintrust for evals, tracing and monitoring agent quality in production

title: Senior Counsel, Strategic Partnerships
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Coursera + Udemy</strong></p> <p>Coursera and Udemy are now one company, bringing together two mission-driven brands to create the world’s most powerful platform for turning learning into progress. Together, we help more than 300 million learners and 12,000+ enterprise customers build the skills they need for a world being reshaped by AI.</p> <p><strong>Why join us now?</strong></p> <p>AI is transforming how people learn, work, and grow, and the need for new skills has never been greater. Coursera brings trusted content and credentials from leading university and industry partners, while Udemy brings a dynamic skills marketplace and global network of real-world experts. By combining these strengths, we can connect more people and organizations to the skills they need, when they need them.</p> <p><strong>Shape what comes next</strong></p> <p>By joining our team, you’ll have the opportunity to reshape how the world learns and applies skills—and help millions of people participate in the new economy. Bring your ideas, expertise, and perspective to meaningful work that can make a difference at global scale.</p></div><p><strong>Where we Work</strong></p> <p>Udemy is a global company headquartered in San Francisco, with additional U.S. offices in Denver and Austin, and international hubs in Australia, India, Ireland, Mexico, and Türkiye.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>About this role</strong></p> <p>This is a senior in-house legal role for a commercially driven lawyer ready to take commercial legal programs work with partners and negotiate technology deals. The role reports directly to the Head of Commercial Legal, Strategic Growth.<br>&nbsp;<br>We operate a hybrid go-to-market model that combines demand-led direct sales, solution-led growth, and indirect distribution through a tiered partner and channel ecosystem. We reach organizations globally through technology alliances, GSI relationships, channel partners, and reseller arrangements — powering learning and capability-building at scale. Legal sits at the center of all three motions.<br>&nbsp;<br>You will be a dedicated legal partner for B2B Enterprise, Technology Alliances, and Channel and Distribution Partnerships, supporting the development and negotiation of the indirect partner ecosystem that underpins our scalable distribution. This is a role for someone who combines deep transactional expertise with strong business instincts, operates with a high degree of independence, and is ready to grow into broader leadership responsibility within a scaling legal function.</p> <p><strong>About your skills</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>Exceptional business judgement and a proven ability to balance legal risk with commercial objectives in fast-moving deal environments.</p> </li> <li> <p>Executive-level communication skills: able to distill complex issues into clear, actionable guidance and influence stakeholders from SMB to large enterprise and C-suite.</p> </li> <li> <p>A track record of using approved AI tools to increase legal productivity, and staying current on AI governance obligations.</p> </li> </ul> <p><strong>What you’ll be doing </strong>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>B2B Enterprise, Ecosystems and Technology Transactions</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>Take primary ownership of drafting, reviewing, and negotiating complex commercial agreements across global system integrator arrangements, channel partner and reseller agreements, technology alliance and co-sell agreements, enterprise SaaS and platform licensing, API and technical integration agreements, and distribution and go-to-market partnerships.</p> </li> <li> <p>Advise senior business stakeholders, including GTM leadership, and Product teams, on deal structuring, risk allocation, commercial terms, and multi-jurisdictional GTM considerations, serving as the day-to-day legal lead who positions Legal as a genuine business enabler.</p> </li> <li> <p>Partner with the Product Legal team to develop and refine legal frameworks that support a self-serve and low-touch commercial motion, including API access agreements, developer terms, usage-based licensing structures, and SMB onboarding frameworks, contributing to a standardized, scalable approach that enables businesses to engage and onboard with speed and minimal friction.</p> </li> <li> <p>Provide clear, solution-focused guidance on AI-related commercial arrangements, data-sharing agreements, and emerging technology implementations as they enter the enterprise deal mix.</p> </li> <li> <p>Own and continuously develop the suite of enterprise and channel contracting templates, playbooks, negotiation guidelines, and approval frameworks used across the partnerships function.</p> </li> <li> <p>Design scalable legal infrastructure that empowers fast-moving deal teams to execute efficiently while maintaining sound risk controls across both direct and indirect channels.</p> </li> <li>&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>GTM Product Commercialisation and Third-Party Integration</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>Act as a primary legal partner for the commercialisation of GTM products, advising on go-to-market structures, route-to-market models, pricing and packaging frameworks, and the legal terms that govern how products are brought to market directly and through third parties.</p> </li> <li> <p>Draft and negotiate agreements that govern the embedding, bundling, or distribution of our products within third-party platforms, marketplaces, and ecosystems, including white-label arrangements, OEM agreements, co-branded offerings, and platform integration terms.</p> </li> <li> <p>Advise on licensing boundaries and revenue-sharing constructs as the product suite evolves and is commercialised through an expanding range of direct and indirect channels.</p> </li> <li> <p>Work closely with Product, Product Legal, Marketing, and Sales to ensure commercial and legal structures keep pace with product development and new route-to-market initiatives, flagging and resolving legal considerations early in the product lifecycle.</p> </li> </ul> <p><strong>What you’ll have&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>Genuinely commercial in your approach: able to identify and manage risk pragmatically, find workable solutions under pressure, and avoid being a blocker to growth.</p> </li> <li> <p>An effective communicator and influencer, comfortable advising and challenging senior stakeholders across Sales, Product, and Executive leadership.</p> </li> <li> <p>Qualified lawyer with 10+ years of post-qualification experience, including meaningful in-house tenure at a technology, SaaS, or enterprise software company.</p> </li> <li> <p>A proven track record negotiating complex B2B technology agreements including GSI, channel, reseller, alliance, and enterprise platform deals, ideally within or alongside global organisations.</p> </li> <li> <p>Demonstrable experience advising on product commercialisation, route-to-market strategy, or third-party distribution and embedding arrangements.</p> </li> <li> <p>Comfortable operating across both high-touch enterprise deals and high-volume standardised indirect channel frameworks, understanding that each requires a different legal posture.</p> </li> <li> <p>Highly organised and self-directed, with a demonstrated ability to manage a high-volume deal workload across competing priorities and deadlines with minimal supervision.</p> </li> <li> <p>A collaborative team player who understands their place in a broader legal function and actively supports those around them, including upward to leadership</p> </li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Posting Date: </strong>15 September 2026<br><strong>Application Window: 2 weeks</strong><br>We anticipate the application window will be open until 30 September 2026.   • Analyse key operations demand drivers (contact per customer, reason drivers, seasonality, servicing behaviour).

  • Work on high-visibility, high-impact projects that directly shape the future of Lendable’s operations.

This is a two-team leadership role with separate roadmaps, production responsibilities and technical domains. The teams should deliver independently, with explicit contracts and joined-up ownership where their services connect.

You will own the health, delivery and growth of both teams and make the trade-offs that keep them effective as a portfolio. You will not be expected to be the deepest expert in every language or domain. You will need enough technical breadth and current engineering judgement to engage credibly in designs, reviews and incidents across both teams, set direction with strong senior engineers, and recognise when the right answer is to create space for their expertise.

The kind of person we're looking for

The successful candidate leads first. They are an experienced engineering manager who can inherit two capable teams, earn trust quickly and help each become a high-performing, value-delivering part of the wider Docker organisation. They are deliberate about where they spend their attention, protect both teams from becoming the second priority, and make portfolio trade-offs visible rather than allowing urgency, proximity or the loudest stakeholder to decide.

They stay close to the technical work without trying to own every technical decision. They can hold a substantive conversation about distributed backend systems, event and data pipelines, build and CI infrastructure, trust boundaries and production operations. They are active in design and review, useful during incidents and willing to get hands-on where that moves the work forward. The balance still tilts strongly to leadership, coaching, delivery and organisational judgement.

They care about security as a product and engineering property, not only as compliance. They understand how modern attacks exploit identity, secrets, dependencies and build systems, and they can reason about the evidence customers need to trust an artefact or workflow. They lead through judgement, clarity and unblocking rather than ceremony for its own sake. Above all, they grow the engineers around them and help both teams ship outcomes developers and enterprises can rely on.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead Secure Build and SCS Services, owning delivery, team health, growth, performance and operational excellence across both.

  • Turn two changing roadmaps into a coherent portfolio plan with explicit priorities, capacity and trade-offs, and create leadership coverage so neither team becomes the permanent second priority.

  • Partner with Product to shape strategy and roadmaps for secure build, Docker Scout, Docker Hardened Images and the services that connect them.

  • Stay close to the technical work through design and code review, incident response and selective hands-on contribution where it adds leverage.

  • Ensure each team's technical direction supports product, security, reliability and customer priorities, setting it collaboratively with Staff and senior engineers while leaving clear decision ownership with them.

  • Own the interfaces between the teams, including trust boundaries, contracts, data quality, versioning, operational ownership and customer-facing failure modes.

  • Balance new product work with inherited systems and on-call, and invest in reliability improvements driven by recurring operational pain.

  • Own engineer growth and performance, handle difficult conversations directly, hire and retain strong people and build succession depth within both teams.

  • Align Product, Design, Security, DHI Content, Registry, Hub, sales, support, commercial and legal partners while shielding the teams from churn.

  • Lead disciplined use of AI-assisted engineering and communicate decisions, risks and progress clearly across UK and US working hours.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

  • 5+ years managing high-performing engineering teams, with meaningful responsibility across more than one team or distinct technical domain.

  • 8+ years of professional, hands-on software engineering experience in backend, infrastructure, platform or developer tooling.

  • Experience leading, growing and retaining engineers at or above your own technical seniority, including teams you did not build and difficult performance conversations.

  • A leader-first operating model, with current enough technical judgement to participate in design and review across unfamiliar systems without needing to be the best engineer in the room.

  • Experience prioritising across competing roadmaps, operational load and stakeholder commitments, with clear mechanisms for allocating attention and capacity.

  • Strong backend and distributed-systems judgement, including APIs, event-driven architectures, data stores, cloud-native infrastructure and production operations.

  • Understanding of CI or build-system internals, containers and artefact workflows, plus a strong interest in software supply-chain security and trust boundaries.

  • Experience leading teams that operate production infrastructure through on-call, incident response, observability, SLOs and the work required to reduce recurring operational load.

  • Strong product judgement and evidence of shaping roadmaps with Product rather than only receiving requirements.

  • Clear written and verbal communication, strong cross-functional influence, customer closeness and comfort leading a remote-first organisation across European and US time zones.

Helpful, but Not Required

  • Experience with Go, Clojure or both, and evidence of becoming effective across a polyglot estate.

  • Experience with Kafka, Spanner, Datomic or comparable event-streaming and distributed-data systems.

  • Experience with OCI, BuildKit, Buildx, GitHub Actions or comparable build and CI platforms.

  • Experience with sandboxing, microVMs, untrusted workload execution or multi-tenant infrastructure.

  • Experience with SLSA, in-toto, SBOMs, VEX, Sigstore, cosign, provenance, signing or vulnerability scanning.

  • Experience evolving legacy systems while shipping new capability for developer tools, security products, regulated customers or software-agent workflows.

What to expect

First 30 days

  • Build relationships with every engineer and the Product partners for both teams before changing structure, process or roadmap.

  • Understand Secure Build's product direction, production estate and on-call load, including Docker Build Cloud and Docker Hub Automated Builds.

  • Understand the SCS Services products, customers, architecture and operational profile, and map the dependencies, trust boundaries and ownership lines between the teams.

First 90 days.

  • Own a coherent portfolio plan with both teams and Product, including explicit capacity for roadmap, reliability and cross-team work.

  • Establish a sustainable operating cadence and leadership coverage that prevents either team depending on your constant presence.

  • Agree ownership and escalation paths for shared services and failures, start one material improvement in each team and make progress and risk visible.

One year Outlook

  • Both teams deliver predictably against a portfolio that connects secure build, Scout and Docker Hardened Images outcomes without collapsing their distinct missions.

  • Secure Build has delivered material trusted-build or secure-CI capability and reduced operational risk in its inherited production systems.

  • SCS Services has delivered material customer outcomes, while both teams have sustainable on-call, clearer ownership and senior engineers leading broader work.

Compensation & Equity

We work toward a future where people live</span> <span data-contrast="none">longer, healthier lives, communities flourish, and economies thrive. This is an ambitious vision, and it inspires us and our partners to make progress every day.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></p></div><p>Resolve to Save Lives' Prevent Epidemics program works closely with Ministries of Health and national public health institutes in Africa to strengthen epidemic preparedness capacity, accelerate disease detection and response, and effectively use data to inform action. In addition to direct partnerships with governments, we also work with implementing partners, including the US CDC, the World Health Organization, the World Bank, and the Global Health Advocacy Incubator, to implement programs, prototype innovations, and ensure sustainability through increased national ownership, including domestic budget allocations.</p> <h3><strong><span data-contrast="none">Position Purpose</span></strong></h3> <p><span data-contrast="auto">The Senior Technical Advisor, Data Use and Decision Science, focuses on bridging the gap between complex epidemiological and contextual data and strategic public health action. This role will accompany in-country counterparts to generate stronger analytics and information products to support decision-making, integrating disease surveillance data with other contextual (e.g., climate, environmental, risk, and vulnerability) data. The role will also contribute to the facilitation of two flagship programs - Epidemic Intelligence training curriculum and a co-design workshop - to build national counterparts' capacity for epidemic intelligence and systems thinking. The Senior Technical Advisor reports to the Principal Advisor, Data Use for Decision Science, Epidemic Intelligence. </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto"><strong>Duration:</strong> This full-time, remote position is for a fixed term of 24 months.</span></p> <h3><strong><span data-contrast="none">Core Duties and Responsibilities</span></strong></h3> <p><span data-contrast="auto">The Senior Technical Advisor, Data Use and Decision Science, collaborates with HQ-based staff and in-country embedded teams on data analytics innovations and delivery. Responsibilities include:</span><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></p> <h4><strong><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-parastyle="No Spacing">Data Use for Decision Science</span></span></strong></h4> <ul> <li><span data-contrast="auto">Support the implementation of epidemic intelligence activities that inform decision-making, including developing innovative data description: Lieu :    Lyon                                                                           Date souhaitée de démarrage :  11/01/2027 Durée :  6 mois                                                              « S’engager aux côtés d’HI, c’est agir pour venir en aide aux populations vulnérables que nous soutenons sur le terrain. Pour mener à bien cette mission, nous recherchons des étudiants motivés et prêts à mettre leur énergie au service d’une cause qui a du sens » HI, Humanité & Inclusion est une organisation de solidarité internationale indépendante et impartiale, qui intervient dans les situations de pauvreté et d’exclusion, de conflits et de catastrophes. Œuvrant aux côtés des personnes handicapées et des populations vulnérables, elle agit et témoigne, pour répondre à leurs besoins essentiels, pour améliorer leurs conditions de vie et promouvoir le respect de leur dignité et de leurs droits fondamentaux. Chez Handicap International, nous croyons fermement en l'importance de l'inclusion et de la diversité au sein de notre structure. C'est pourquoi nous sommes engagés dans une politique handicap afin de favoriser l'accueil et l'intégration de personnes en situation de handicap.   Merci d’indiquer si vous avez besoin d’un aménagement particulier, y compris pour participer aux 1ers entretiens.    Pour plus d’information sur l’association : www.hi.org   OBJECTIFS DU STAGE : Le stage se fera au sein du service Sensibilisation - Communication de Handicap International, au siège de Lyon, dans le cadre des missions quotidiennes du service avec un large volet dédié à l’organisation des déploiements des Pyramides de chaussures. Être un soutien au service Sensibilisation - Communication dans leurs actions de sensibilisation et tout projet.  Nous vous invitons à prendre connaissance des actions de sensibilisation et mobilisation en consultant : l’Espace du bénévolat et de la sensibilisation pour Handicap International . La mission se déroulera du 11 janvier au 10 juillet 2027 (6 mois). Les Pyramides de chaussures c’est le temps fort de sensibilisation et de mobilisation citoyenne pour Handicap International. Depuis plus de 30 ans, tous les citoyens, scolaires, salariés d’entreprises, sympathisants de Handicap International ou encore politiques sont invités à venir : -          Lancer leurs chaussures pour témoigner de leur soutien aux causes portées par Handicap International, la chaussure symbole de l’engagement citoyen pour protéger les civils ; -          S’informer à travers une exposition interactive, ludique et pédagogique sur Handicap International, ses champs d’intervention et ses combats ; -          Rencontrer et échanger avec nos experts terrain Depuis 2024 Handicap International a développé des Pyramides de chaussures dites « mobiles ». Le but ? Être présent toute l’année partout en France. Grâce à ce dispositif nous pouvons aller au plus proche de nos différentes cibles (scolaire, sympathisants, grand public, élus, médias) et leur proposer un temps de sensibilisation complet sur nos missions dans le monde. Pour en savoir plus sur les Pyramides : https://www.handicap-international.fr/fr/pyramides-de-chaussures Le stage sera orienté autour de trois volets  -          Appui à la prospection (recherche de structures hôtes ou de partenaires intéressés par des visites guidées) -          Appui événementiel et logistique pour la préparation et le déroulement des déploiements. -          Animation auprès du public (visites guidées, actions de sensibilisation, échanges lors d’évènements). Le stage implique des déplacements réguliers (environ deux par mois) dans le cadre des animations et évènements extérieurs. Ces missions sont l’occasion de belles rencontres et d’échanges enrichissants avec des publics variés. Le stage combine la prospection de nouveaux lieux de déploiement, l'appui à la coordination événementielle et logistique et l'animation auprès de publics variés. Une bonne connaissance des actions, des valeurs et des prises de position de Handicap International est nécessaire pour adapter les messages de sensibilisation au contexte géopolitique. Activité 1 : Participer à la préparation et au déploiement des Pyramides de chaussures 2027 -          Prospection : identifier et contacter des villes, structures et partenaires susceptibles d'accueillir une Pyramide ; contribuer au suivi des contacts et des opportunités. -          Coordination logistique : participer aux rétroplannings, à la préparation du matériel, à la mobilisation des bénévoles et à l'organisation opérationnelle des déploiements. -          Relations avec les partenaires et prestataires : recherche de contacts, coordination, suivi des engagements, communication et fidélisation. -          Participation aux événements en France : appui à la coordination sur place, installation et démontage, animation de visites guidées, prises de parole et échanges avec les publics. -          Bilans et capitalisation : recueillir les retours d'expérience, contribuer aux bilans et à l'amélioration des outils et procédures. Activité 2 : Soutenir l'organisation d'événements portés par d'autres services -          Appuyer, selon les besoins, la logistique, la communication ou la prospection pour des événements transversaux (par exemple : vœux, inauguration des nouveaux locaux, Congrès des Notaires ou autres temps forts de l'association). raw.description:
Lieu :    Lyon                                                                           Date souhaitée de démarrage :  11/01/2027

Durée :  6 mois                                                             

« S’engager aux côtés d’HI, c’est agir pour venir en aide aux populations vulnérables que nous soutenons sur le terrain. Pour mener à bien cette mission, nous recherchons des étudiants motivés et prêts à mettre leur énergie au service d’une cause qui a du sens »

HI, Humanité & Inclusion est une organisation de solidarité internationale indépendante et impartiale, qui intervient dans les situations de pauvreté et d’exclusion, de conflits et de catastrophes. Œuvrant aux côtés des personnes handicapées et des populations vulnérables, elle agit et témoigne, pour répondre à leurs besoins essentiels, pour améliorer leurs conditions de vie et promouvoir le respect de leur dignité et de leurs droits fondamentaux.

Chez Handicap International, nous croyons fermement en l'importance de l'inclusion et de la diversité au sein de notre structure. C'est pourquoi nous sommes engagés dans une politique handicap afin de favoriser l'accueil et l'intégration de personnes en situation de handicap.  

Merci d’indiquer si vous avez besoin d’un aménagement particulier, y compris pour participer aux 1ers entretiens. 

 

Pour plus d’information sur l’association : www.hi.org

 

OBJECTIFS DU STAGE :

Le stage se fera au sein du service Sensibilisation - Communication de Handicap International, au siège de Lyon, dans le cadre des missions quotidiennes du service avec un large volet dédié à l’organisation des déploiements des Pyramides de chaussures. Être un soutien au service Sensibilisation - Communication dans leurs actions de sensibilisation et tout projet. 

Nous vous invitons à prendre connaissance des actions de sensibilisation et mobilisation en consultant : l’Espace du bénévolat et de la sensibilisation pour Handicap International.

La mission se déroulera du 11 janvier au 10 juillet 2027 (6 mois).

Les Pyramides de chaussures c’est le temps fort de sensibilisation et de mobilisation citoyenne pour Handicap International. Depuis plus de 30 ans, tous les citoyens, scolaires, salariés d’entreprises, sympathisants de Handicap International ou encore politiques sont invités à venir :

-          Lancer leurs chaussures pour témoigner de leur soutien aux causes portées par Handicap International, la chaussure symbole de l’engagement citoyen pour protéger les civils ;

-          S’informer à travers une exposition interactive, ludique et pédagogique sur Handicap International, ses champs d’intervention et ses combats ;

-          Rencontrer et échanger avec nos experts terrain

Depuis 2024 Handicap International a développé des Pyramides de chaussures dites « mobiles ». Le but ? Être présent toute l’année partout en France. Grâce à ce dispositif nous pouvons aller au plus proche de nos différentes cibles (scolaire, sympathisants, grand public, élus, médias) et leur proposer un temps de sensibilisation complet sur nos missions dans le monde. Pour en savoir plus sur les Pyramides : https://www.handicap-international.fr/fr/pyramides-de-chaussures

Le stage sera orienté autour de trois volets 

-          Appui à la prospection (recherche de structures hôtes ou de partenaires intéressés par des visites guidées)

-          Appui événementiel et logistique pour la préparation et le déroulement des déploiements.

-          Animation auprès du public (visites guidées, actions de sensibilisation, échanges lors d’évènements).

Le stage implique des déplacements réguliers (environ deux par mois) dans le cadre des animations et évènements extérieurs. Ces missions sont l’occasion de belles rencontres et d’échanges enrichissants avec des publics variés.

Le stage combine la prospection de nouveaux lieux de déploiement, l'appui à la coordination événementielle et logistique et l'animation auprès de publics variés. Une bonne connaissance des actions, des valeurs et des prises de position de Handicap International est nécessaire pour adapter les messages de sensibilisation au contexte géopolitique.

Activité 1 : Participer à la préparation et au déploiement des Pyramides de chaussures 2027

-          Prospection : identifier et contacter des villes, structures et partenaires susceptibles d'accueillir une Pyramide ; contribuer au suivi des contacts et des opportunités.

-          Coordination logistique : participer aux rétroplannings, à la préparation du matériel, à la mobilisation des bénévoles et à l'organisation opérationnelle des déploiements.

-          Relations avec les partenaires et prestataires : recherche de contacts, coordination, suivi des engagements, communication et fidélisation.

-          Participation aux événements en France : appui à la coordination sur place, installation et démontage, animation de visites guidées, prises de parole et échanges avec les publics.

-          Bilans et capitalisation : recueillir les retours d'expérience, contribuer aux bilans et à l'amélioration des outils et procédures.

Activité 2 : Soutenir l'organisation d'événements portés par d'autres services

-          Appuyer, selon les besoins, la logistique, la communication ou la prospection pour des événements transversaux (par exemple : vœux, inauguration des nouveaux locaux, Congrès des Notaires ou autres temps forts de l'association).

title: Lead Architect - Digital Assets
description: We are hiring on behalf of our client, an established, leading European regulated financial institution who is expanding its digital assets capabilities to build the next generation of financial market infrastructure. The organization is seeking a Lead Architect – Digital Assets to lead a zero-to-one build, bridging traditional capital markets with decentralised finance (DeFi). This mandate involves architecting the core platform behind initial tokenised offerings across two major live initiatives currently in design: Tokenised Issuance, Trading, and Settlement Platform: Supporting equities, ETFs, and bonds with a 24/7 central limit order book, fractional trading, CCP-cleared trades, and end-of-day atomic DvP settlement on-chain. Tokenised Collateral-Management Platform: Designed for sovereign bonds to enable real-time repo, CCP-margin eligibility, and DeFi distribution of government securities through gated lending venues. The architecture is built on core principles: the token serves as the direct financial instrument, one ISIN corresponds to one ledger, and tokenisation is driven directly by the CSD. The Lead Architect will turn these principles into a concrete, secure, resilient, and auditable infrastructure. Requirements Architecture & System Design: Own the end-to-end architecture for digital asset solutions, seamlessly integrating distributed ledger technology (DLT) with traditional market infrastructure (trading, clearing, settlement, custody, and CSD). Cross-Chain & Network Topology: Design cross-chain topology combining permissioned chains for institutional and CCP operations (e.g., Hyperledger Besu, Canton Network) with public chains for DeFi distribution (Ethereum / L2). On-Chain Compliance & Governance: Define regulatory compliance frameworks on-chain, utilizing regulated security-token standards (ERC-3643 / T-REX), KYC-whitelisted wallets, automated transfer restrictions, real-time AML screening (Chainalysis / Elliptic), and transaction reporting under MiFIR. Custody & Key Management: Architect robust custody models around MPC solutions (e.g., Fireblocks, Taurus), incorporating hybrid frameworks to support bring-your-own-custody (BYOC) for institutional clients. Security & Quality Standards: Establish code quality, code review, testing, and secure-by-design standards. Conduct threat modelling and lead security architecture prior to onboarding a dedicated security lead. AI-Augmented Software Delivery: Define, implement, and govern an AI-assisted software delivery process using coding assistants, smart-contract scaffolding, and AI-generated test suites while enforcing strict risk and review guardrails. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with product, legal, regulatory, clearing, CSD, and client working groups to maintain alignment with business objectives and regulatory frameworks (e.g., DLT Pilot Regime, MiFID II, MiCA). Technical & Operational Leadership: Make key build/buy/partner evaluations on blockchain networks, custody, and audit solutions. Guide team evolution as products move from build to operational phases, maintaining hands-on involvement during critical incidents. Requirements Experience: Minimum 7 years of solution architecture experience, including at least 3 years dedicated to DLT or blockchain projects within high-value, 24/7 financial systems. DLT & Distributed Systems Expertise: Deep fluency with EVM and permissioned chains (e.g., Canton, Hyperledger Besu). Regulated Token Standards: Hands-on experience with regulated security token standards (ERC-3643 / T-REX or equivalent), on-chain compliance models, and security considerations around smart contracts and cross-chain bridges. Capital Markets Knowledge: Strong working knowledge of capital markets settlement mechanisms (delivery-versus-payment, CSD operations, CCP/clearing) to effectively design system integrations. AI Engineering Competency: Proven ability to evaluate, select, and integrate AI tooling into the development lifecycle (e.g., testing, scaffolding) while establishing strict guardrails around prompt hygiene, secret security, and license provenance. Ability to specify in-product AI capabilities (e.g., anomaly detection) with proper risk controls. Leadership & Communication: Strong decision-making skills and composure under pressure. Excellent stakeholder management skills to bridge technical, business, legal, and regulatory domains. Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.   2. Tokenised Collateral-Management Platform: Designed for sovereign bonds to enable real-time repo, CCP-margin eligibility, and DeFi distribution of government securities through gated lending venues.

The architecture is built on core principles: the token serves as the direct financial instrument, one ISIN corresponds to one ledger, and tokenisation is driven directly by the CSD. The Lead Architect will turn these principles into a concrete, secure, resilient, and auditable infrastructure.

TL;DR: We are looking for a gap-year or final-year student to work alongside the leadership team on Davis's go-to-market, strategy and growth.


About Davis

Davis is an AI-native real estate company accelerating early-stage development and architectural design. Today developers coordinate four to five fragmented stakeholders over weeks or months. Soon they will need only one: Davis.

We turn every input that shapes a development decision into decision-ready outputs: investor-grade feasibility studies, investment analysis, and architect-certified designs, delivered in days. Every stage pairs our proprietary AI systems with expert review, so velocity never comes at the cost of reliability.

We closed a $5.5M pre-seed co-led by Heartcore Capital and Balderton Capital, with Yellow, Evantic and Entrepreneur First, alongside angels from the founding teams of Spacemaker, Black Forest Labs, Hugging Face, Supabase, Cleo and Spore Bio. We already work with leading developers and expect to support hundreds of projects over the coming year, deepening our research, our hiring, and our coverage of the development process end to end.

The role

The role is cross-functional. You work directly with the whole team: the CEO and the Real Estate Partner as much as the tech teams.

Together with them, you take part in decisions on company strategy, client acquisition and relationships, and product improvement. Your analyses form the basis for these decisions.

Client relationships and deliverables

  • Contribute to studies for our developer and investor clients, from data analysis to final formatting.

  • Incorporate client feedback and improve deliverable quality from one version to the next.

  • Gather client needs and feedback, then turn them into concrete proposals to shape the offer and improve the product.


Product improvement

  • Turn recurring work methods into automated tools and processes, with the tech teams.

  • Formalise the methods and quality standards these tools reproduce.

  • Test these tools on real cases and suggest improvements.

  • Support their adoption by the team: documentation, onboarding, user feedback.

Go-to-market and client acquisition

  • Define the priority client segments and the decision-makers to approach.

  • Build the target account list and identify entry points and partnerships.

  • Prepare prospecting materials and key meetings.

Strategy and planning

  • Maintain the business plan and prepare the analyses that inform leadership decisions, including with investors.

Profile

  • Education: student at a top business or engineering school, on a gap year or in your final year.

  • Experience: a first internship in strategy consulting, investment banking, growth/VC, a leading real estate investment fund or a start-up.

  • Key skills: strong synthesis and presentation skills, a real appetite for AI tools and a genuine interest in the real estate sector.

Analytical skills

  • Ability to study a market (size, dynamics, players, prices, demand), structure it, segment targets and build a clear, verifiable model.

  • Ability to structure a client presentation and deliver it.

  • Rigour and attention to detail in analysis.

  • Strong writing skills, in French and English.

Additional skills

  • Strong intellectual curiosity, with an appetite for real estate and for AI tools.

  • Autonomy and the ability to get up to speed quickly on new topics.

  • Ease in dealing with leadership, clients and partners.

Why join Davis?

You will work closely with the leadership team, with a full view of strategy, business development, clients and product.

You will have broad autonomy and a direct impact on company decisions.

You will learn to use AI as an everyday productivity lever, on high-stakes topics.

Package

  • 6-month full-time internship

  • Offices in Paris 75002

  • Meal vouchers

  • 50% of public transport costs covered

Team

Mehdi (Co-founder & CEO) grew up in a family of architects and has lived this problem firsthand. He's a repeat founder who bootstrapped his first startup at 20, and graduated from Sciences Po and HEC Paris. Amine (Co-founder & CTO) is an AI researcher from École Polytechnique who worked extensively on discrete diffusion and turned down a PhD with Google DeepMind to build Davis. Today we're a team of 12: technical profiles from Polytechnique, ENS and INRIA alongside architects and deep real estate expertise.
