description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At Catawiki, every day brings the extraordinary! Whether it’s <a href="https://www.catawiki.com/en/c/583-sports-memorabilia">Daniel Ricciardo’s Formula 1 Car</a>, a <a href="https://www.catawiki.com/en/c/579-fossils">Woolly Mammoth’s Skeleton</a>, <a href="https://www.catawiki.com/en/l/10035805">Lady Gaga's Jumpsuit</a> or <a href="https://www.catawiki.com/en/c/583-sports-memorabilia">Usain Bolt’s running shoe</a>, we encounter exceptional objects every day.</p> <p>We’re a one-of-a-kind marketplace for buying and selling special objects. Each week, more than 100,000 unique items are auctioned, all carefully curated by our passionate in-house experts.</p> <p>Having sold over 25 million unique objects, our mission is to become the world’s most popular destination for special objects. As a growing, diverse and sustainable scale-up, we proudly live by three core values. If these values resonate with you, we’d love to explore how you can join us.</p> <ul> <li>Taking ownership and driving impact&nbsp;</li> <li>Being open to change and feedback</li> <li>Being passionate about our mission and our customers.&nbsp;</li> </ul></div><h3>Your mission</h3> <p>As Senior Manager – Data Engineering &amp; Machine Learning, you’ll lead Catawiki’s established team of Data Engineers and Machine Learning specialists. You’ll help the team grow, set its technical direction and build on work already underway across data foundations and production machine learning.</p> <p>The role spans two connected disciplines. You’ll bring deep experience in either Data Engineering or Machine Learning Engineering, and enough breadth to set direction across the other.</p> <p>You’ll partner with Product, Engineering, Analytics and business stakeholders to set priorities and connect the team’s work to outcomes across Catawiki.</p> <h3><strong>What you'll do</strong></h3> <p>You’ll lead the team through platform modernisation and product-facing ML work. Current priorities include modernising the infrastructure for serving production models, introducing a feature store to improve feature management and consistency across model training and serving, and strengthening observability and cost controls. You’ll help set priorities and raise the reliability and impact of this work.</p> <ul> <li><strong>Lead and develop the team:</strong> Set direction, coach experienced specialists and create clear ownership across Data Engineering and Machine Learning.</li> <li><strong>Build dependable data foundations:</strong> Improve the pipelines, integrations and infrastructure the wider Data team relies on for analysis, reporting and machine learning.</li> <li><strong>Strengthen production ML:</strong> Improve deployment, monitoring and operational follow-through for production models, so teams can run them reliably and resolve issues effectively.</li> <li><strong>Advance marketplace models:</strong> Help teams improve recommendation, cancellation and bidder-risk use cases, connecting model performance to meaningful product outcomes.</li> <li><strong>Set direction and priorities:</strong> Work with Product, Engineering, Analytics and business partners to choose high-value problems and balance delivery, reliability and long-term platform health.</li> <li><strong>Shape the technology strategy:</strong> Reporting to the SVP Engineering, you’ll join the Engineering Management team and help shape the direction of the Technology department.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What you'll bring</strong></h3> <p>You combine strong technical judgement with experienced people leadership. You create clarity in a complex environment, empower specialists and make sound decisions across both disciplines.</p> <p>Your experience will include the following. Familiarity with Catawiki’s current stack is useful, and equivalent experience with other platforms is welcome.</p> <ul> <li><strong>Technical depth in one discipline:</strong> Deep experience designing, building and operating data-intensive systems in Data Engineering or Machine Learning Engineering, with practical knowledge of the other.</li> <li><strong>People leadership:</strong> Experience leading experienced engineers or ML specialists, coaching their growth and setting clear expectations.</li> <li><strong>Architecture and systems thinking:</strong> Ability to evaluate trade-offs and guide architecture for data platforms, distributed systems and production infrastructure.</li> <li><strong>Production ML understanding:</strong> Experience with the deployment, monitoring and operation of machine learning systems in production.</li> <li><strong>Business and product judgement:</strong> Ability to connect technical work to business goals, make priority calls and assess outcomes.</li> <li><strong>Relevant cloud platform experience:</strong> We run on GCP using BigQuery, Vertex AI and Kubernetes. Experience with equivalent AWS services is also relevant.</li> <li><strong>Streaming and integration experience:</strong> Kafka, event-driven systems or modern data integration tools are useful.</li> <li><strong>Clear communication:</strong> Ability to explain technical trade-offs and align technical and non-technical stakeholders.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>How we work</strong></h3> <ul> <li>You’ll lead a team of eight Data Engineers and Machine Learning specialists across Amsterdam and Lisbon.</li> <li>The team works closely with Product, Engineering, Analytics and business stakeholders to connect data and ML capabilities to real needs.</li> <li>Specialists own implementation while you set direction, priorities and clear standards.</li> <li>The team supports production data and ML systems, and has no on-call rotation.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Where you'll be</strong></h3> <p>This is a <em>hybrid</em> role in Amsterdam. You will work from our Amsterdam HQ a minimum of 2 days per week.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><div class="text text-align-left "> <h3><strong>Why You'll Love Working with Us</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Create a visible impact </strong>by working at scale in a global organisation serving millions of customers across 80+ categories. In our flat structure, every role has a broad scope and directly impacts both our customers and the business.</li> <li><strong>Learn and grow</strong> through our Learning &amp; Development initiatives, including clear development plans and mentorship programmes to support your career progression.</li> <li><strong>A culture of connection defines us</strong>. We’re a passionate, diverse team of 800+ Catawikians representing 60+ nationalities. We foster an inclusive and queer-friendly environment where everyone is encouraged to bring their full self to work.</li> <li><strong>Celebrate life’s moments with us. </strong>You’ll receive a €100 Catavoucher when you join, a €50 Catavoucher on your birthday, and an extra day off each year to “Pursue Your Passion<strong>”</strong>. We also offer additional leave for key work anniversaries and important life events. Benefits may vary by location.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Our Offices and Way of Working</strong></h3> <p class="p1">Our vibrant offices in Amsterdam and Lisbon are designed to inspire collaboration. Most Catawikians operate in a hybrid setup, combining office-based and remote work, with a minimum of two days per week in the office, unless a role is explicitly stated as fully remote or fully office-based.</p> </div> <h3><strong>Interested?</strong></h3> <p class="p1">Apply with an English CV and Cover Letter. By applying, you agree to <a href="https://www.catawiki.com/conditions/applicant-privacy-policy.pdf">Catawiki’s Applicant Privacy Policy.</a> If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.<br><br>We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support the review of your application. Join us in shaping the future of treatment access - making tomorrow’s therapies accessible for people who need them today. 

The opportunity: Real-World Data Associate

As a Real-World Data Associate at myTomorrows, you will support the design and execution of real-world data collection within Expanded Access Programs and other non-interventional studies. Working closely with the Real-World Data team, you will help keep communication with clients, physicians and site staff running smoothly, carry out data validation and quality-control tasks, and contribute to the documentation that supports consistent, high-quality RWD delivery. This is a great opportunity to build hands-on experience in real-world data within a purpose-driven, fast-growing company.

Given that most of our team is located in the Netherlands, we only consider candidates for this position who live within commuting distance to our office in Amsterdam.

  • Support the design and day-to-day execution of RWD collection within Expanded Access Programs and other non-interventional studies.

  • Assist in maintaining communication with clients, physicians and site staff about data collection and data management.

  • Help monitor RWD collection and completion, flagging data discrepancies or missing data for follow-up.

  • Perform basic data validation, cleaning and quality-control tasks in electronic data capture systems.

  • Follow relevant regulatory requirements, internal procedures and ICH-GCP principles in all RWD study activities.

  • Support the preparation and maintenance of SOPs, templates and study documentation for RWD projects.

  • Share observations and ideas that could improve data collection, workflows and supporting tools.

  • Work under the guidance of more senior team members, collaborating closely with colleagues across the team and other relevant functions.

title: Production Engineer
description: Monumental is automating on-site construction with robotics and software. Our mission is to make construction software-defined and autonomous - a future where beautiful, bespoke buildings go up in a single day, with minimal labour. We're a growing team of engineers, operators and technicians from companies like Palantir, Qualcomm, Dyson, Shopify, Tesla, Meta and Google DeepMind. It's still the early days of building the company, and this is a chance to make an outsized impact on a problem that matters. From day one, you’ll be working with an experienced founding team, backed by a $32M Series B led by Khosla Ventures and Plural. Monumental is based in the city centre of Amsterdam, in a beautiful facility with an fully equipped workshop and robot testing floor. We build the whole stack in-house - hardware and software, we're explicitly not a hybrid or remote-first company - you can't build robots or walls from home, so we're onsite five days a week. Read more on why we believe you should spend your time working on construction, and learn about our vision and company . You might enjoy Based in Europe’s film on how we’re fixing Europe’s housing shortage , or this video by Andreas Klinger of what our office looks like . About the role Monumental are already deploying robots into the real world at scale, building beautiful, bespoke homes. Our robots are on sites across the Netherlands and the UK and will be in the US within a year. Every deployment teaches us something about our hardware; you’ll push our R&D fleet to become one ready for large-series production: you'll own taking us from tens of robots a year to hundreds, and then thousands. You'll also keep that growing fleet deployable, and making design changes yourself to improve reliability and serviceability. AI powers how we operate and innovate, with more than 60,000 active AI agents helping our teams build, scale and move faster. Through our investment team, we also back the founders and technologies shaping the future: From robotics and autonomous systems to synthetic biology and frontier AI. Guided by our five values Innovation, Results, People, Impact, and Entrepreneurship, culture is our competitive advantage. We thrive with experimentation; we build, we test, we learn, we iterate. The scale of ambition is real; the challenge now is focus, coherence, and velocity. As Group Product Manager for our AI Platform, you will own the multi-year product strategy for the platform that underpins every AI initiative across Prosus. This means defining and sequencing the roadmap for agent infrastructure, evaluation frameworks, model deployment pipelines, and the shared capabilities that internal teams — from applied science to application engineering — rely on to build and ship AI products. You will balance long-term platform investments against the immediate, high-impact needs of teams across the portfolio who are racing to deliver. You will lead and mentor a team of product managers, instilling product discipline and building the PM talent pipeline that scales with the platform. You will partner closely with engineering and applied science leadership to shape the technical strategy — making the hard trade-offs between model performance, latency, cost, and reliability that determine what we can promise the business. And you will be the connective tissue: the person who turns ambiguous, fast-moving business needs into clear requirements, who aligns stakeholders across functions and geographies, and who ensures that what we build is not just technically impressive but adopted, trusted, and measurably impactful. You can engage substantively with engineering and applied science teams on model lifecycle, MLOps, evaluation frameworks, and infrastructure trade-offs — not as a bystander, but as a thought partner. You have worked in fast-paced, high-scale environments where priorities shift and the path forward is not always clear. You do not wait for perfect information — you run rapid experiments, test hypotheses, and let data and user feedback guide the next step. You are a communicator. You can simplify complex technical concepts for executive leadership one hour and dig into detailed requirements with an engineering team the next. You build trust across functions and geographies, and you are as comfortable pushing back as you are building consensus. You are customer-obsessed — even when your customers are internal teams. You connect frequently with the people who use your platform, validate solutions through product discovery, and treat adoption as a first-class metric. What You Bring 8+ years in product management, with at least 3–5 years in formal people-management roles leading a team of product managers. Demonstrated success owning platform-level or infrastructure products used by internal teams — ideally including AI/ML platform capabilities, MLOps tooling, or developer-facing services. Hands-on experience with generative AI, LLMs, and the model lifecycle (training, fine-tuning, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring) in production environments. Track record of defining and executing multi-year product strategies in fast-moving, high-scale environments. Technical Depth Ability to engage substantively with engineering and applied science teams on architectural decisions, infrastructure trade-offs, and AI system design. Familiarity with agentic workflows, agent frameworks, and the operational patterns that make AI agents reliable at scale. Strong data-driven decision-making: comfortable with analytics tooling, A/B testing, defining and tracking KPIs, and using metrics to measure adoption, accuracy, latency, and ROI. Experience with modern product and engineering tooling (e.g., Databricks, Jira, Confluence, Figma) and agile methodologies. Leadership & Influence Proven ability to mentor and grow product managers, instilling PM best practices and building talent pipelines. Stakeholder management across functions and geographies — aligning engineering, applied science, business teams, and executive leadership around a shared roadmap. A bias toward ownership: you take accountability for outcomes, protect your engineers' focus, and course-correct execution without waiting to be asked. Mindset Customer-first: you translate needs into technical requirements, push back when scope dilutes value, and advocate relentlessly for the people who use your platform. Comfort with ambiguity: you structure complex problems, propose pilots to validate direction, and create clarity for new and evolving teams. AI intuition: you stay current on models, frameworks, and evaluation methods — not as a researcher, but with the hands-on curiosity of a builder. Why Prosus? At Prosus, your colleagues include 60,000 AI agents… and your job is to figure out what that actually means. We're one of the largest operators of agentic AI on the planet, inside a $100B+ portfolio across 100+ companies and two billion people. What you'll be doing:

  • Ship growth experiments, fast: Take ideas from our growth backlog and get them live: landing pages, tools, ads and content. Run plenty of them, keep what works and kill what doesn't.

  • Get Tebi recommended by AI: Own our visibility in ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini and Google's AI Overviews. Create and update content built to be cited, not just published, and track how often we show up compared with competitors.

  • Build tools operators actually use: Build free tools, calculators and templates for restaurant owners, and scale our programmatic landing pages. Use no-code, AI and vibe coding tools to ship without waiting on engineering.

  • Run creative campaigns: Help launch scrappy, unconventional campaigns across markets, from competitive campaigns to guerrilla and partner media, with the support of our Marketing team.

  • Turn word of mouth into a channel: Test referral and sharing ideas that turn merchant word of mouth into a steady flow of demo requests. Work with our Product Growth team to build the winners into the product.

  • Keep paid and organic working together: Support our performance agency with landing pages, creative tests and tracking.

  • Measure everything: Keep the experiment log up to date: hypothesis, cost, result and next step. Set up tracking and UTMs properly so we know what actually drove each demo.

  • Experiments shipped each month, and what we learned from them

  • Demo requests from organic and other non-paid channels

  • How often Tebi appears in AI answers for our category, by market

  • Experience marketing to small businesses, or a background in hospitality

  • Vibe-coding projects you're proud of

  • Competitive Salary

  • Lunch Provided in Office

  • Team building events

  • Unlimited time off

Restaurants and other merchants use various software systems such as Point of Sale (POS), Reservations, Kitchen Display Systems (KDS), Payments, Inventory, Staffing, and the list goes on. These systems all need to speak to each other which they frequently don’t. It’s a mess, and we are fixing it.

From buying a croissant at a cafe to having dinner with friends, it’s a €4 Trillion+ global market and a critical part of everyday life in today's economy.

We use AI the way our merchants use Tebi, to cut out the friction and get to what matters faster. We believe in a world where AI increases quality, efficiency and speed.

At Tebi, AI isn't a policy or a checkbox, it's just part of how we work. It helps us write, analyse, build, and improve but doesn’t make the last call. If there's a smarter way to do something, we want to find it.

raw.title: Events & Community Manager
raw.description:
About us:

Tebi is creating the first Connected Restaurant Management System that makes hospitality flow. In one seamless platform, Tebi embeds sales, reservations, kitchen prep, payments, and all the data that powers it, creating smooth service and intuitive insights.

Founded by Arnout Schuijff, co-founder of Adyen, and backed by €50 million in funding from Index Ventures & CapitalG, Tebi is built in service of hospitality first. Thousands of restaurants, cafés, bars, and coffee shops across the Netherlands, UK, Italy, Spain, Germany, Denmark and Finland already love running on Tebi.

About the role:

Restaurant owners trust other restaurant owners. They listen to the chef down the street, their wine supplier and their accountant long before they listen to an ad. That's why our events work. When we launched in Berlin, we hosted a four-hands dinner with two local merchants and a well-known food creator. We believe that’s what builds credibility, trust, and ultimately a warm prospect list.

We’re hiring an Events & Community Manager to turn that into a program that runs in several markets at the same time. You’ll plan and run our partner and owned events, and find new ways to grow Tebi through the hospitality community in each city, neighbourhood and market. You’ll work closely with our local sales teams so every event and partnership turns into real conversations.

This is a hands-on role. One week you'll be hosting a merchant dinner in Milan, the next you'll be setting up a distributor breakfast in Amsterdam. You'll report to the Head of Marketing and work closely with our Marketing team to extend these programs to our channel ecosystem, plus align closely with the General Managers and Account Managers in each market.

What you'll be doing:

  • Run events across markets: Plan and deliver partner and owned events in 2–3 markets at a time, from intimate merchant dinners and industry breakfasts to city launches. You own the calendar, budget, venues, suppliers, guest lists and the plan for the night.

  • Build the playbook as you go: Turn each event into templates, checklists and supplier lists, so we can launch a city campaign in weeks, not months. Improve them after every event.

  • Build local partner networks: Find the people operators already trust: drinks distributors, wholesalers, food creators, hospitality associations, accountants and the advisers who help new venues open. Build partnerships that bring us introductions and referrals, not just logos.

  • Put our merchants front and center: Work with our best merchants as hosts and anchors, so prospects hear about Tebi from the people they respect.

  • Turn connections into pipeline: Agree with local Sales and Account Management who to involve, how to follow up and who owns what conversations. Track every event in HubSpot from invite to demo to signed merchant.

  • Grow Tebi through the community: Find new ways to reach operators through the people and places they already trust, in each city, neighborhood and across borders. Keep guests and partners engaged after events, so one introduction leads to the next.

  • Open new community channels: Test new ways to grow through our close-knit industry, such as an affiliate or referral program for partners, sharing useful insights from our merchants, and showing up in the forums and groups where operators talk shop.

  • Capture the stories: Work with our creative team and relevant freelancers to turn events and partner moments into social content, case studies and sales material.

How we'll measure success:

  • Events delivered each quarter across markets, on time and on budget

  • Demos, pipeline and new merchants from each event and partnership

  • Introductions, referrals and leads from partners, affiliates and community channels

  • Cost per demo compared with our other channels

What you’ll bring:

  • Have built something people show up for: an event series, a supper club, a community, a program. You can point to what it led to, not just how many people came

  • Feel at home in hospitality. You've worked in or around restaurants, bars or food and drink brands, and you're comfortable leading a room full of operators

  • Are high agency. You own your calendar, your relationships and your results, and you don't wait to be told what to do

  • Build your own playbook when there isn't one, and you enjoy doing the work as much as planning it

  • Know the difference between a real community and a guest list

  • See growth opportunities beyond events, and are curious enough to test them

  • Can run several markets at once without dropping details, and are happy to travel regularly

  • Track what you do: comfortable with a CRM (HubSpot a plus), UTMs and simple reporting

  • Speak fluent English. Dutch, German, Italian, Spanish or a Nordic language is a plus

Typically this means 3–5 years in events, community, field marketing or partnerships, but we care more about what you've built than how long you've been doing it.

This role isn't for you if:

  • You'd rather plan the program than run it

  • You need a fixed playbook and a clear org chart to get going

  • You're not willing to roll up your sleeves on the night

Benefits:

  • Start-up Equity

  • Competitive Salary

  • Lunch Provided in Office

  • Team building events

  • Unlimited time off

What is Restaurant Software?

Restaurants and other merchants use various software systems such as Point of Sale (POS), Reservations, Kitchen Display Systems (KDS), Payments, Inventory, Staffing, and the list goes on. These systems all need to speak to each other which they frequently don’t. It’s a mess, and we are fixing it.

From buying a croissant at a cafe to having dinner with friends, it’s a €4 Trillion+ global market and a critical part of everyday life in today's economy.

How we use AI at Tebi

We use AI the way our merchants use Tebi, to cut out the friction and get to what matters faster. We believe in a world where AI increases quality, efficiency and speed.

At Tebi, AI isn't a policy or a checkbox, it's just part of how we work. It helps us write, analyse, build, and improve but doesn’t make the last call. If there's a smarter way to do something, we want to find it.

title: Senior Product Manager, Sovereign & Hybrid Deployments
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth.</strong></p> <p>Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.</p> <p>Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.</p> <p>As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.</p> <p>We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.</p> <p>Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.</p></div><p><strong>About the Role:&nbsp;&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>Planet is expanding its platform capabilities to support customers who require dedicated, in-region, or on-premises instantiations of our core platform. As the Senior Product Manager for Sovereign &amp; Hybrid Deployments, you will drive the productization of our platform for isolated, air-gapped, and hybrid environments.</p> <p>You will serve as the critical bridge between high-touch enterprise customer delivery and scalable core engineering. In this role, you will balance deep customer empathy with product discipline—translating complex operational requirements into repeatable core platform capabilities while establishing clear extension points for Professional Services.</p> <p>This is a full-time, hybrid role which will require you to work from our Berlin, Haarlem or Ljubljana office 3 days per week.</p> <p><strong>Impact You’ll Own:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Conduct deep-dive discovery with high-security enterprise and government stakeholders to understand their operational realities, using those insights to set clear, defensible product priorities.</li> <li>Define and structure the explicit, phased customer journey framework—establishing the operational models, readiness criteria, and governance standards for initial platform installation, joint-operations training, and the final transition into fully autonomous, customer-operated environments with zero or limited vendor access.</li> <li>Translate customer operational and security requirements into clear technical specifications for Core Infrastructure and Engineering teams with detail-oriented accuracy. Synthesizes underlying commonalities across clients who describe similar operational needs using different language, preventing costly, redundant engineering effort.</li> <li>Define standardized building blocks that allow the core platform to extend safely into varying edge and air-gapped environments without hardcoding custom variants for every deployment.</li> <li>Define clear boundaries for what belongs in the core platform versus what can be customized. Design clear hooks and interfaces so Professional Services and integration partners can build custom extensions without modifying core platform code.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You Bring:</strong></p> <ul> <li>6+ years of relevant work experience in Technical Product Management focusing on enterprise platforms, hybrid cloud deployments, or complex infrastructure products.</li> <li>Ability to sit down with enterprise or government clients, listen to complex operational workflows, and identify the root problem behind divergent customer terminology.</li> <li>Track record productizing cloud-native software platforms to deploy into customer-managed infrastructure, enterprise VPCs, or air-gapped data centers.</li> <li>Ability to apply conceptual understanding of enterprise hybrid patterns similar to AWS Outposts, Azure Stack, Kubernetes-based enterprise distribution platforms (e.g., Red Hat OpenShift), or infrastructure automation frameworks (e.g., HashiCorp Terraform/Vault).</li> <li>Experience setting clear boundaries between core platform roadmap items and custom extensions delivered by Professional Services.</li> <li>Detail-oriented mindset capable of mapping out complex operational transitions, training milestones, and access handoffs.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What Makes You Stand Out:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Prior experience navigating European sovereign cloud frameworks, regional data residency mandates, or EU defense/government compliance standards.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Application Deadline:</strong></p> <p>11:45p / 23:45 CET on the date stated below. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. This posting may be removed earlier than projected if a suitable pool of applications has been received. For this reason, we recommend applying as soon as you are able to.</p> <p><strong>Benefits While Working at Planet:</strong></p> <p><em>These offerings are dependent on employment type and geographical location, based upon applicable law or company policy.</em></p> <ul> <li>Paid time off including vacation, holidays and company-wide days off&nbsp;</li> <li>Employee Wellness Program&nbsp;</li> <li>Home Office Reimbursement</li> <li>Monthly Phone and Internet Reimbursement</li> <li>Tuition Reimbursement and access to LinkedIn Learning</li> <li>Equity&nbsp;</li> <li>Volunteering Paid Time Off</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compensation:</strong></p> <p>The expected starting gross salary range for this role is listed below. Individual placement within this range is determined objectively based on gender-neutral criteria such as your skills, qualifications, and professional experience. This position may also be eligible for discretionary bonuses and/or equity.</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="title">Netherlands Salary Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>€75.000</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>€93.700 EUR</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance<br></strong>Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.<strong><br></strong></p> <p><strong>Why we care so much about Belonging.&nbsp;<br></strong>We’re dedicated to helping the whole Planet, and to do that we must strive to represent all of it within each of our offices and on all of our teams. That’s why Planet is guided by an ultimate north star of Belonging—dreaming big as we approach our ongoing work.&nbsp; If this job intrigues you, but you’re thinking you might not have all the qualifications, please... do apply!&nbsp; At Planet, we are looking for well-rounded people from around the world who can contribute to more ways than just what is listed in this job description.&nbsp; We don’t just fill positions, we aspire to fulfill people’s careers, most excited about folks who are motivated by our underlying humanitarian efforts.&nbsp; We are a few orbits around the sun before we get to where we want to be, so we hope you’re excited to come along for the ride.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>EEO statement: <br></strong>Planet is committed to building a community where everyone belongs and we invite people from all backgrounds to apply. Planet is an equal opportunity employer, and committed to providing employment opportunities regardless of race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, pregnancy, childbirth and breastfeeding, age, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other protected classification, in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. <a href="https://www.eeoc.gov/sites/default/files/2023-06/22-088_EEOC_KnowYourRights6.12.pdf">Know Your Rights.</a></p> <p><strong>Accommodations:&nbsp;<br></strong>Planet is an inclusive community and we know that everyone has their own needs. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation during the hiring process, please reach out to ----- or contact your recruiter with your request. Your message will be confidential and we will be happy to assist you.</p> <p><strong>Privacy Policy</strong>: By clicking "Apply Now" at the top of this job posting, I acknowledge that I have read the <a href="https://www.planet.com/privacy/#california">Planet Data Privacy Notice for California Staff Members and Applicants</a>, and hereby consent to the collection, processing, use, and storage of my personal information as described therein.</p> <p><strong>Privacy Policy (European Applicants):</strong> By clicking "Apply Now" at the top of this job posting, I acknowledge that I have read the <a href="https://www.planet.com/privacy/">Candidate Privacy Notice GDPR Planet Labs Europe</a>, and hereby consent to the collection, processing, use, and storage of my personal information as described therein.</p> <p><strong>AI in Our Interviewing Process</strong>: Planet is committed to providing an exceptional interview experience for all candidates. We currently use <a href="https://www.metaview.ai/" target="_blank">Metaview</a> to better focus on candidates and less on trying to capture notes. Should an interview involve use of AI interview technologies, the candidate will receive notification and have the ability to opt out both in advance and/or real-time. Opting out will not affect one's candidacy.</p> <p><strong>Candidate AI Policy</strong>: Planet embraces Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools, and we encourage its responsible use. That is…until now.

  • Out-of-the-box AI solutions for optimizing networks, allocating inventory, scheduling routes, planning fulfillment capacity, promising orders, propagating demand, building predictions, analyzing scenarios, and more, plus

Today, a growing number of Fortune 500 companies, including Smurfit WestRock, Estée Lauder, Coca-Cola, and more, are innovating on their own terms with Lyric. We can’t wait to see what our customers, both current and future, are empowered to build with us next. Come build with us!

We’re looking for an experienced Account Executive to join our growing enterprise sales team. Even if you don’t meet 100% of the qualifications, we recommend applying to the role!

title: Senior ML Engineer | Kimchi (Inference Stack Optimization)
description: <h4>Why Kimchi?</h4> <p>Great models are raw ingredients. Kimchi is what happens when you ferment them with good engineering. Are you an experienced Python Software Engineer with a passion for developing high-quality, scalable back-end solutions? Join our team to work on challenging projects using cutting-edge technologies for leading companies in the Netherlands and Belgium! As part of a cross-functional DevOps team at the client’s site, you will create innovative microservices, APIs, and distributed systems. You will also contribute to implementing robust testing frameworks and optimizing system performance with modern technologies tailored to the client’s specific needs. 
 
Why Join Us? 
 
At Wypoon Technologies, you’ll work on dynamic projects for industry leaders such as Heineken, ING, ASML, Philips, and Shell, tackling exciting challenges and delivering tailored enterprise solutions.
 
Here’s what makes us stand out: 
✔ Impactful Work: Shape the future of our clients’ digital landscapes.
✔ Innovative Environment: Collaborate within a supportive team that values learning and growth.
✔ State-of-the-art Technology: Access the latest tools and platforms.
󠁯✔ Global Opportunities: Dreaming of living and working in the Netherlands or Belgium?  We provide full support with visa processes, making your transition smooth and hassle-free!

Key Responsibilities
  • Develop scalable solutions: Write clean, maintainable, and efficient back-end code. 
  • Microservices and APIs: Design, build, and enhance microservices and RESTful/GraphQL APIs to enable seamless system integration. 
  • Testing frameworks: Implement and maintain tools such as PyTest and Unittest to ensure high code quality. 
  • Distributed systems: Work with event-driven architectures using technologies such as Kafka and Redis. 
  • Infrastructure-as-Code: Use tools like Terraform or Ansible to deploy and manage resources. 
  • DevOps practices: Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and deploy applications to cloud platforms (e.g., Azure/AWS). 
  • Collaboration: Participate in sprint planning, peer reviews, and team discussions to continuously improve development processes. 
  • Documentation: Create and update clear and comprehensive documentation for architecture, processes, and best practices. 

    • Preferred Experience
  • At least 8 years of professional experience. 
  • Advanced proficiency in English (minimum B2 level in speaking, writing, listening, and reading). 
  • A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field. 
  • Expertise in Python and frameworks such as Django, Flask, or FastAPI. 
  • Proficiency with testing tools such as PyTest or Unittest. 
  • Experience with test-driven development (TDD) or behavior-driven development (BDD). 
  • Strong knowledge of distributed systems and event-driven architecture using echnologies such as Kafka, Redis, or Celery. 
  • Hands-on experience in designing, building, and scaling microservices. 
  • Proficiency in API design patterns (e.g., RESTful APIs, GraphQL). 
  • Familiarity with containerization and container management using Docker and Kubernetes. 
  • Experience with Linux systems, including scripting and system management. 
  • Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud. 
  • Proficiency with CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps).
  • Familiarity with additional programming languages (e.g., Go, Java, or Rust) is a plus. 
  • Experience with secure coding practices and knowledge of cybersecurity principles. 
    •  

    What We Offer
  • Competitive Compensation: Salary tailored to your skills and experience. 
  • Generous Time Off: 25 paid vacation days (based on a 40-hour work week). 
  • Currently living in the Netherlands and available to work on-site/hybrid when required
  • Travel Reimbursement: We've got your daily commute covered.

  • Professional Development: Financial support for certifications, technical training, and language courses—because we value your long-term career growth.

  • Comprehensive Relocation Assistance: Extensive support to help you settle in smoothly. 
  • Community & Fun: Enjoy team events and connect with developers from around the globe!

Education • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field. • Relevant accounting or Accounts Payable certifications are considered an advantage. THE ROLE

Are you looking to join a dynamic, fast-growing international fashion and retail company? We are seeking an experienced and detail-oriented Senior Accounts Payable Coordinator to support our Finance team. 

This role is responsible for managing the end-to-end accounts payable process, ensuring timely and accurate invoice processing, payment execution, vendor management, and compliance with internal controls.

The ideal candidate has experience working with Finance ERP, Medius AP Automation, and possesses a solid understanding of the Purchase Order (PO) lifecycle within a retail environment. You will thrive in a fast-paced international setting, demonstrate strong organizational skills, and maintain a high level of accuracy and professionalism.

Reporting directly to the Accounts Payable Team Lead, you will play a key role in supporting the financial operations of the business.

 


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Invoice Processing & Vendor Management

• Process supplier invoices accurately and efficiently through Medius and M3, ensuring compliance with company policies and procedures.
• Perform thorough validation of invoice documentation and coding, allocating costs to the correct financial dimensions, entities, and cost center.
• Monitor and manage invoice workflows, ensuring timely approvals and resolution of exceptions.
• Maintain vendor master data, including the creation, modification, and validation of supplier records.
• Develop and maintain strong relationships with external vendors and internal stakeholders.

Purchase Order Management

• Review and validate invoices against approved Purchase Orders and Goods Receipts.
• Investigate and resolve PO-related discrepancies, including price variances, quantity mismatches, and missing receipts.
• Work closely with Procurement, Retail Operations, and business stakeholders to ensure adherence to the Purchase-to-Pay (P2P) process.
• Support continuous improvement of PO compliance and invoice automation processes.

Payments & Cash Management

• Prepare and process weekly payment runs, including both batch and manual payments, ensuring adherence to agreed payment terms.
• Respond promptly to supplier inquiries regarding payment status and account reconciliations.
• Record and reconcile bank transactions accurately within the accounting system.

Reconciliations & Controls

• Perform regular supplier statement reconciliations and proactively resolve discrepancies.
• Monitor AP aging balances and follow up on outstanding items to ensure timely resolution.
• Support month-end and year-end closing activities related to accounts payable.
• Ensure compliance with internal controls, financial policies, and audit requirements.
• Assist with internal and external audits by providing supporting documentation and responding to audit requests.

Team & Administrative Support

• Manage shared Accounts Payable mailboxes, ensuring effective communication and timely handling of requests.
• Process employee expense claims in accordance with company policies and approval procedures.
• Contribute to the continuous improvement of Accounts Payable processes and finance operations.
• Support day-to-day Finance department activities as required.

THE PROFILE:

Experience & Knowledge

• Minimum 3-4 years of Accounts Payable experience, preferably within an international retail, fashion, or consumer goods environment.
• Hands-on experience with M3 ERP and Medius AP Automation is highly preferred.
• Strong understanding of the Purchase-to-Pay (P2P) process, including Purchase Orders, Goods Receipts, and invoice matching.
• Good knowledge of European VAT regulations and invoice compliance requirements.
• Experience with vendor reconciliations, payment processing, and month-end activities.

Education

• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.
• Relevant accounting or Accounts Payable certifications are considered an advantage.

Skills & Competencies

• Strong analytical skills with exceptional attention to detail and accuracy.
• Ability to prioritize workload effectively and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
• Strong problem-solving capabilities and proactive mindset.
• Professional integrity with a commitment to confidentiality and compliance.
• Proficient in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel.
• Fluent in English, both written and spoken; Spanish is a plus.

What We Offer

• The opportunity to work for globally recognized fashion and lifestyle brand.
• A collaborative and international working environment.
• Career development opportunities within a growing organization.
• Exposure to end-to-end finance operations and continuous process improvement initiatives.
